stat_facts: Increases health and reduces chance to be dazed in combat (wiki Statistics; '1 STA = 1 HP' is marked 'need testing' there).
Increases melee and ranged weapon damage and shield block amounts; 1 STR = 2 weight (wiki Statistics).
Increases hit rate, weapon proc frequency and gives a channeling bonus to spellcasters (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if INT is higher than WIS, and offensive spell damage (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if WIS is higher than INT, and healing done; 4 mana per WIS point for WIS-based classes (wiki Statistics).
Merchant prices and charm break rate on paper; the wiki notes CHA did not seem to affect vendor prices in beta (May 2026).
class_mod: +2 STR, +4 STA, +2 WIS (wiki Paladin Creation Guide)

mana.text: The official Paladin page mentions mana costs, but no spell on the wiki list has a numeric mana cost, so which stat sets your mana is not sourced yet.
mana.label: UNVERIFIED

builds.name: Tank (default)
builds.why: Paladins tank in plate with a shield (official). STA health, AGI mitigation, STR damage and block.

builds.name: Healer-tank
builds.why: The official page describes fast emergency heals at a high mana cost. WIS raises healing, and mana for races whose WIS beats INT (see the mana note).

build_caveat: Point totals are from the wiki race pages (10 bonus points for every listed race/class). Whether a stat has a per-point cap or diminishing returns at creation is not documented on the wiki: UNVERIFIED.

traits.why: Tough: +5% STA and a 15-second +50% STA emergency button.
Shieldman: Block at 5 (+25%) and a Trainee's Buckler for shield tanking from level 1.
Forage finds food and drink in the field, so fewer vendor runs. Paladins may take it. Infravision or Ultravision only if your race may take it (see the race note).

race_pick.Halfling: Infravision (you already have Forage as a racial)

traits.why: Miner starts Mining at 25 with a Trainee's Mining Pick and Pouch, matching the default gathering setup (Mining, Lumberjacking, Smelting) for early coin. Medic (Bind Wound 25 and bandages) is the safer pick if you expect downtime between fights. Blacksmith exists but smithing stays off by default here.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.

why.mining: Gathering for coin; pairs with the Miner trait (this Codex's default set).
why.smelting: Turns ore into sellable bars (separate skill on the wiki).
why.lumberjacking: Second gathering skill for coin, part of the default set.
why.bind-wound: Bandaging between pulls cuts downtime for classes without strong self-heals.

tradeskills.note: Gathering defaults plus Bind Wound. Smithing stays off. STRATEGY.
